views.label: Fleet from the inventory file
views.note: No manager: the TOML says which BMCs exist, and each gets its own session.

views.label: The 25-plus-GET walk per BMC
views.note: Systems first, then every sub-collection; one that cannot be read becomes None, never zero.

views.label: One write per changed server
views.note: Classify, evaluate health, audit; a changed server is written with a revision CAS, an identical one only touch_seen'd (ADR-0044).

messages.label: hosts + per-host credential, or a bad file: exit 1
POST SessionService/Sessions → auth token header
messages.note: mid-run 401 re-login, at most 3 a client

messages.label: GET Processors, Memory, EthernetInterfaces, Storage, Volumes, Drives, HPE SmartStorage
GET Chassis PSUs + PowerSupplyMetrics, GPU metrics, optional PCIe devices, Managers
Forbidden, protocol error or unreachable on a sub-collection → None + unread_fields
messages.note: Storage tree absent (404/501/503) → RAID UNKNOWN; failed → unread

messages.label: whole host fails → serial-less stub; unreachable/rejected exit 0, TLS/budget/protocol exit 3
messages.note: unexpected error: COLLECTION_ERROR; a bad ComputerSystem on a multi-system BMC keeps its own identity

messages.label: classify + health + audit; changed: revision CAS, else touch_seen

cards.title: Cost is per server, not per manager
items: Each host costs about 25 GETs or more (Volumes, metrics, optional PCIe); a UCS domain costs ~11 whether it holds 10 servers or 500 (ADR-0016, Context)
Hosts run in parallel under INVENTORY_REDFISH_FLEET_CONCURRENCY, shuffled so a truncated sweep never starves the same slow hosts
Supported range is ~400–1,000 hosts per CronJob; run budget via redfish.run_budget_exceeded, exit 3 (arc42 §11)

cards.title: None means could not read, never zero
items: A Storage 404 once wrote zeros over good data and flipped a server with a failed disk from CRITICAL to HEALTHY (ADR-0016, 'A partial read silently heals a real fault')
Now a Forbidden, protocol or unreachable sub-collection is None; IngestService carries the stored value forward and lists the path in Server.unread_fields

A host that gives nothing still yields a serial-less stub named by inventory name or host, matched by (source_provider, BMC host). Unreachable or rejected login exits 0; anything else makes the run PARTIAL, exit 3 (ADR-0037, ADR-0062)

cards.title: Credentials stay in the CronJob
items: The fleet and per-host logins come from inventory.toml and credentials.toml mounted into the CronJob pod (redfish-standalone-collector-cronjob.yaml)
Unlike the manager collectors' Secret, these files are never mounted into the Route-exposed API pod (ADR-0032 §6)
A session is opened per BMC and deleted on exit; Basic auth would cost an LDAP round trip per GET (ADR-0016)

cards.title: Deployment and exits
items: The CronJob is suspend: true by default, in the server-scan-collectors chart (ADR-0060); the type is exempt from the global name pattern
A bad inventory file exits 1 and missing credentials exit 2; POST /servers/{id}/refresh answers 409 SERVER_REFRESH_UNSUPPORTED (ADR-0064)
A mid-run 401 re-logs in, capped at 3 per client (ADR-0016, 2026-09-17)
